<type>file</type>
<content>
1: // Per-run permission profiles, injected through OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT.
2: // The user's OpenCode config (models, providers, keys) is never modified, and no
3: // model is chosen here: agents without a `model` use OpenCode's configured default.
4: //
5: // Every rule is "allow" or "deny", never "ask": `opencode run` is non-interactive,
6: // so an "ask" would stall or silently reject. Later keys win in OpenCode, so the
7: // broad "*" rule comes first and specific rules follow.
8: import os from 'node:os';
9: import path from 'node:path';
10: import type { Mode } from './store.js';
11: 
12: export const AGENT = { read: 'pitroom-read', write: 'pitroom-write' } as const;
13: 
14: type Rule = 'allow' | 'deny';
15: type Perm = Rule | Record<string, Rule>;
16: 
17: const READ_FILES: Record<string, Rule> = {
18:   '*': 'allow',
19:   // Keep secrets away from third-party / free model providers.
20:   '*.env': 'deny',
21:   '*.env.*': 'deny',
22:   '*.env.example': 'allow',
23:   '*.env.sample': 'allow',
24:   '*.pem': 'deny',
25:   '*id_rsa*': 'deny',
26:   '*id_ed25519*': 'deny',
27: };
28: 
29: const READ_ONLY_BASH: Record<string, Rule> = {
30:   '*': 'deny',
31:   'git status*': 'allow',
32:   'git diff*': 'allow',
33:   'git log*': 'allow',
34:   'git show*': 'allow',
35:   'git grep*': 'allow',
36:   'git blame*': 'allow',
37:   'git ls-files*': 'allow',
38:   'ls*': 'allow',
39:   pwd: 'allow',
40:   'rg *': 'allow',
41:   'wc *': 'allow',
42:   // Flags that would let "read" commands execute or write.
43:   'rg *--pre*': 'deny',
44:   'git *--output*': 'deny',
45:   'git *--ext-diff*': 'deny',
46: };
47: 
48: const FORBIDDEN_BASH = [
49:   // history, branches and anything that can discard uncommitted work
50:   'git commit*', 'git push*', 'git reset*', 'git checkout*', 'git restore*', 'git clean*',
51:   'git stash*', 'git rebase*', 'git merge*', 'git switch*', 'git branch*', 'git tag*',
52:   'git rm*', 'git worktree*', 'git update-ref*', 'git filter-branch*', 'git filter-repo*',
53:   'git gc*', 'git prune*', 'git reflog*', 'git config*', 'git remote*', 'git cherry-pick*',
54:   'git revert*', 'git am*', 'git add*', 'git mv*', 'git pull*', 'git -C*', 'git --git-dir*', 'git --work-tree*',
55:   // git by absolute path would bypass the PATH shim (see guard.ts)
56:   '/*/git*',
57:   // bulk deletion and privilege
58:   'rm -rf*', 'rm -fr*', 'rm -r *', 'rm -R *', 'rm --recursive*', 'sudo *', 'su *', 'doas *',
59:   'chown *', 'chmod -R*', 'dd *', 'mkfs*', 'shutdown*', 'reboot*',
60:   // killing processes could kill the primary agent
61:   'kill *', 'pkill*', 'killall*',
62:   // publishing / remote side effects
63:   'gh *', 'npm publish*', 'pnpm publish*', 'yarn publish*', 'cargo publish*', 'twine upload*',
64:   // no recursive delegation
65:   'opencode*', 'pitroom *', '*pitroom*',
66: ];
67: 
68: /** OpenCode's own scratch dirs must stay readable (large tool outputs are spilled there). */
69: function scratchDirs(): Record<string, Rule> {
70:   const data = process.env.XDG_DATA_HOME ?? path.join(os.homedir(), '.local', 'share');
71:   return {
72:     '*': 'deny',
73:     [path.join(data, 'opencode', 'tool-output', '*')]: 'allow',
74:     [path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'opencode', '*')]: 'allow',
75:   };
76: }
77: 
78: const COMMON: Record<string, Perm> = {
79:   skill: { '*': 'allow', 'opencode-worker': 'deny' },
80:   task: 'deny', // subagents carry their own, broader permissions
81:   question: 'deny', // nobody is there to answer
82:   doom_loop: 'deny',
83: };
84: 
85: /**
86:  * Web tools are off unless asked for: a prompt injection hidden in the repo could
87:  * otherwise make a read-only worker send code to an arbitrary URL.
88:  */
89: const web = (on: boolean): Record<string, Rule> => ({ webfetch: on ? 'allow' : 'deny', websearch: on ? 'allow' : 'deny' });
90: 
91: export function readProfile(allowWeb = false): Record<string, Perm> {
92:   return {
93:     '*': 'deny',
94:     read: READ_FILES,
95:     glob: 'allow',
96:     grep: 'allow',
97:     list: 'allow',
98:     lsp: 'allow',
99:     codesearch: 'allow',
100:     todowrite: 'allow',
101:     todoread: 'allow',
102:     ...web(allowWeb),
103:     bash: READ_ONLY_BASH,
104:     edit: 'deny',
105:     external_directory: scratchDirs(),
106:     ...COMMON,
107:   };
108: }
109: 
110: export function writeProfile(allowWeb = false): Record<string, Perm> {
111:   const bash: Record<string, Rule> = { '*': 'allow' };
112:   for (const pattern of FORBIDDEN_BASH) bash[pattern] = 'deny';
113:   return {
114:     '*': 'allow',
115:     read: READ_FILES,
116:     ...web(allowWeb),
117:     bash,
118:     external_directory: scratchDirs(),
119:     ...COMMON,
120:   };
121: }
122: 
123: export function agentFor(mode: Mode): string {
124:   return mode === 'read' ? AGENT.read : AGENT.write;
125: }
126: 
127: /** Builds OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT, merged over any value the user already set. */
128: export function configContent(existing: string | undefined, allowWeb = false): string {
129:   const ours = {
130:     agent: {
131:       [AGENT.read]: {
132:         mode: 'primary',
133:         description: 'pitroom: read-only worker (research, search, review)',
134:         permission: readProfile(allowWeb),
135:       },
136:       [AGENT.write]: {
137:         mode: 'primary',
138:         description: 'pitroom: editing worker (no git history changes, no bulk deletes)',
139:         permission: writeProfile(allowWeb),
140:       },
141:     },
142:   };
143:   let base: unknown = {};
144:   if (existing?.trim()) {
145:     try {
146:       base = JSON.parse(existing);
147:     } catch {
148:       base = {};
149:     }
150:   }
151:   return JSON.stringify(deepMerge(base, ours));
152: }
153: 
154: function deepMerge(a: unknown, b: unknown): unknown {
155:   if (!isObject(a) || !isObject(b)) return b;
156:   const out: Record<string, unknown> = { ...a };
157:   for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(b)) out[k] = k in out ? deepMerge(out[k], v) : v;
158:   return out;
159: }
160: 
161: function isObject(v: unknown): v is Record<string, unknown> {
162:   return typeof v === 'object' && v !== null && !Array.isArray(v);
163: }

(End of file - total 163 lines)
</content>
